_help: Page text that is not the author's prose, read by scripts/site_build.py. The author's sentences go in site/user_text.md; timeline rows in site/log.json; upstream findings in site/upstream.json; public upstream events in site/events.json (scripts/site_events.py --refresh); the card's examples in site/card_pick.json (scripts/site_card.py). Placeholders in braces are filled by the build.
title: A care-gap agent. No alert until code re-checks the evidence.
subtitle: Flags a missing statin under the 2026 ACC/AHA guideline. Every claim cites a record row, a risk calculation or a “not on record” query.
how_it_works: The agent queries the record with tools: labs, diagnoses, medications, notes. It computes 10-year risk with the PREVENT equations.
It answers with a status and a list of claims. Each claim cites a record row, a risk calculation, or a “not on record” query.
Code re-reads every cited row, recomputes every risk and re-runs every “not on record” query. A failed claim sends the draft back once. If it fails again, no alert is shown.
how_it_works_note: The verifier never sees the answer key. It re-checks the cited evidence and the arithmetic, not the guideline decision.
test_lead: Delete the lab result. The alert should withdraw itself.
test_pre: About {n} test records: synthetic patients as generated, and edited copies of them. Each edit changes one thing. Some edits must flip the answer. Some must not. The run happens once, and the numbers land here whatever they are.
